summary: A companion to The Ultimate Rubber Guard that separates its historical discussion from positional study and the omoplata section.
description: Navigate the rubber-guard sections of Eddie Bravo’s course without relying on an invented list of mandatory position chains.
overview: The public chapter list is broad: evolution and full rubber guard each occupy a volume. Use those headings to organize study, and record the instructor’s position names as they appear rather than assuming the listing specifies their order.

fits: You want the rubber-guard portion of Eddie Bravo’s course and need to find the positional material.
consider_alternative_if: For seated butterfly posture and sweep study, compare Marcelo Garcia’s Butterfly Guard guide.

includes: Rubber-guard history, evolution, positional material and an omoplata section.
limits: The listing does not break every named rubber-guard variation into its own lesson; bottom half occupies a separate, shorter section.

start_here.title: Separate positional lessons from history
start_here.task: Locate the omoplata section in volume 1 and the full positional section in volume 3. Use the first as an attack-specific destination and the second as the wider study block. If watching the course, log the control present immediately before each named position changes; leave unclear contacts as questions.

sources.title: The Ultimate Rubber Guard by Eddie Bravo
sources.note: Verified four volumes, instructor, rubber-guard history and omoplata coverage, and the Bottom Half section. Listing and official trailer iframe inspected; player content and playback not reviewed.

sources.note: Verified posture/control, sweeping, distance, standing-opponent and pressure sections in four volumes. Listing inspected; course video content not reviewed.
